name: This Is Fine
visual_description: Two-panel comic strip of an anthropomorphic dog sitting at a table drinking coffee surrounded by raging fire, calmly saying 'This is fine.'
usage_context: Conveys feigned calm, denial, or coping mechanisms in the middle of a worsening disaster or chaotic situation.

text_areas.description: Top caption stating the chaotic crisis or looming disaster
Bottom caption emphasizing the denial, apathy, or worsening reality
